title: Steps Taken to Ensure Recyclables Collected in Government Campaigns are Not Misused
what_it_is: Steps Taken to Ensure Recyclables Collected in Government Campaigns are Not Misused

sections.label: National Recycling Programme requirements
sections.summary: Licensed collectors must send recyclables to licensed facilities, which must meet requirements and cannot transfer e-waste overseas unless standards are met.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Under the National Recycling Programme, Public Waste Collectors licensed by NEA are required to send collected recyclables to licensed materials recovery facilities for sorting, processing and recycling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Recycling facilities are licensed by NEA and must meet requirements, such as ensuring that their operations do not endanger public health, only receiving and processing the waste stream approved in its licence and submitting records to NEA on the amount of waste received and processed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The recyclers contracted by the scheme operators are not allowed to transfer e-waste collected under the scheme overseas unless they are able to demonstrate that the foreign recycler is able to treat the e-waste to a similar or better standard.

sections.label: Monitoring recycling landscape
sections.summary: The Ministry and NEA will continue to monitor the recycling landscape and strengthen processes as necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: My Ministry and NEA will continue to monitor our recycling landscape and strengthen our processes as necessary.

sections.label: Shoes collected and deployed
sections.summary: Since the project started, 10,000 kilogrammes of shoes have been collected and deployed into existing facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Which is why we have been able, since the project started, to collect 10,000 kilogrammes of shoes and have already deployed them into the existing facilities that we have.

sections.label: Tighter contractual mechanisms possible
sections.summary: Tighter contractual mechanisms are possible, including oversight, checks, unannounced audits and reports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On Mr Zhulkarnain's point about having tighter contractual mechanisms, it is possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, some oversight, some checks, some unannounced, some audits, and some reports can be put in place.

sections.label: Lax accounting caused problems
sections.summary: Problems came from a lax system for proper accounting and lack of segregated sorting, and steps have been taken to correct this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: What, as we can tell from the investigation, resulted in the problems that we have seen, came from a lax system for proper accounting and not allowing them to be properly sorted in segregated sections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And so, steps have been taken to correct this between Alba and its various other sub-contractors – those that it may appoint in place of Yok Impex.

sections.label: Assessment of tyre versus shoe material
sections.summary: An assessment was made, and old tyres have a different rubber density from shoes, which better suit the running track and playgrounds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The short answer is yes, there was such an assessment made.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And to take Mr Singh's comparison, without overly going into technical details, the rubber density of old tyres is quite different from that of the shoes that you see and the extent to which we want a certain density at the running track and on the playgrounds, they rely better and use better the materials from the shoes rather than old tyres.

sections.label: Contractor investigations ongoing
sections.summary: The contractor that engaged the sub-contractor is conducting ongoing investigations, and material findings may be raised again in the House.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To Dr Tan's second question, investigations are being done by the contractor which engaged the sub-contractor and they are currently ongoing, and I will leave the investigation as they were.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: If there are any other findings that are material, then we can raise this again in this House.

sections.label: Yok Impex collections tainted
sections.summary: Investigations currently show that only the Yok Impex collections have been tainted with this finding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The fact of the matter is that as far as the investigations show, it is only the Yok Impex collections that have been tainted with this finding based on information we have currently.
